description: This Java class defines a custom TrustManagerFactory that creates TrustManagers which only trust X.509 certificates that are currently valid based on their 'not before' and 'not after' dates, without performing signature verification. It is part of the org.eclipse.hono.service.auth package and enhances SSL/TLS trust validation logic.

classes.name: ValidityOnlyTrustManagerFactory
classes.description: A TrustManagerFactory that provides TrustManagers which validate only the certificate validity period.

methods.name: checkClientTrusted
methods.description: Checks if the client's X.509 certificate chain is currently valid based on its 'not before' and 'not after' dates.

methods.name: engineInit
methods.description: Initializes the factory with a KeyStore or ManagerFactoryParameters; here, no operation is needed.

methods.name: engineGetTrustManagers
methods.description: Returns an array with a single TrustManager implementing the validity-only trust logic.
